data.narrative: Module 04 applied JSON-always request-correlated logging and pull-based Prometheus metrics, then corrected metric overflow and alert-scoping defects found during BREAK. Focused tests and local build checks passed; Docker, PostgreSQL, live HTTP/scrape, and promtool verification remain explicitly unexecuted.

dimension_scores.observation: The selected json_always and pull_prometheus decisions were translated into explicit logging, correlation, metrics, and alert contracts.
dimension_scores.evidence: The observability build, fix, and reflection artifacts trace required fields, route-template labels, HTTP counter/histogram behavior, and alert expressions.

dimension_scores.observation: The review followed the overflow misclassification, cross-job alert aggregation, global latency aggregation, sensitive diagnostic patterns, and request-ID edge cases.
dimension_scores.evidence: The FIX added overflow, route-aware, absent-target, email/JWT redaction, line-break, and missing/overlong-ID checks; all focused Jest runs passed.

dimension_scores.observation: The fix pass targeted high-value correctness issues without adding dependencies or changing Prisma/package metadata.
dimension_scores.evidence: Overflow now uses a non-5xx label plus a dedicated counter; alert expressions are service/route-aware; dependency installation was unnecessary.

dimension_scores.observation: The verification record separates local source/unit evidence from blocked runtime and monitoring-system checks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Docker named-pipe denial, PostgreSQL TCP False, and promtool absence are recorded; live Docker, DB, HTTP, scrape, and PromQL validation are NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: The deliverable connects corrected behavior, regression evidence, operational risks, and concrete rollout gates.
dimension_scores.evidence: Nest build and lint exited 0, nine Jest suites/51 tests passed, alerts parsed into five rules, and git diff --check exited 0.

strengths: Corrected the series-cap overflow label so it cannot be counted as a fabricated HTTP 500, and exposed overflow through a dedicated counter and alert.
Scoped error-rate alerting to the API job and made latency alerting route-aware; added missing-target detection.
Extended redaction and request-ID edge coverage while documenting the exact boundaries of local versus live verification.
data.recommendation: Before rollout, validate the rules with promtool, restrict /metrics to the monitoring network, configure the actual scrape job and notification receiver plus an independent dead-man's-switch, publish HTTPS runbooks, and run Docker and url_shortener_test-backed HTTP/scrape checks in staging.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Explains why a capacity overflow must not create a synthetic 500 and verifies a separate bounded overflow counter.
Distinguishes service-level error-rate alerting from route-level p95 latency and absent-target detection.
Separates passing local tests/build/YAML parsing from NOT EXECUTED Docker, PostgreSQL, HTTP, Prometheus scrape, and promtool checks.

teaching_approaches.detail: Used a 600-series unit test to demonstrate the cap, overflow label, and separate counter.
Mapped each local command to the claims it supports and kept unavailable live checks marked NOT EXECUTED.

learning_style_signals: Uses test outputs and exact failure modes to distinguish verified behavior from deployment assumptions.

public_evidence.student_action: Hardened metric overflow semantics, scoped Prometheus alert expressions, and expanded logging/request-ID edge tests.
public_evidence.technical_detail: The metrics exporter now emits a dedicated overflow counter and non-HTTP overflow status; alert rules are scoped to the API job with route-aware latency and missing-target detection.
public_evidence.proof: Nest build and lint exited 0; 9 Jest suites/51 tests passed; alert YAML parsed with five rules. Docker and live PostgreSQL/HTTP/scrape checks were NOT EXECUTED.
public_evidence.ability: Improves observability correctness and validates edge behavior with focused tests.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows that monitoring instrumentation and its alerts are reviewed for semantic correctness, not only successful output.
